name: ProductSnap Studio
summary: The creative studio of Jeevan Koppu, a product leader and builder. Four ideas, all live: ProductSnap, FlickMango, Run It Back and Pulse. He makes the product calls, the design and the QA. AI does the typing.

person.name: Jeevan Koppu
person.bio: Jeevan Koppu is a product leader by day and a builder by habit. He turns “what if?” into “it’s live.”
focus_areas: Building with AI as the build crew
how_he_thinks: Judgment beats content. Nobody needs another article.
Pencil first. Every screen started as a scribble.
Right beats big. A trusted few over a thin many.
AI types. He decides. Taste, product calls and QA stay his.
person.voice: Curious, practical, warm, and a little playful.

products.name: ProductSnap
products.description: A free iOS and Android app that trains product judgment like a muscle, one card at a time.
products.status: Live on the App Store and Google Play. Free, no paywall.

products.name: FlickMango
products.description: A free web app that answers where to watch Indian films, by language and the services you already have.
products.also_peeking_at: Answers that were right the first time.
products.status: Live in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada. No login wall.

products.name: Run It Back
products.description: A free grade 7 math site: pictures, plain words, and practice that feels less like a test.
products.why: Try, miss, and run it back — without a timer.
products.status: Live with every grade 7 topic. No account needed.

products.name: Pulse
products.description: Hand-drawn picture books that explain frontier tech, AI, money and the economy in about five minutes each.
products.why: Big shifts, small books, almost no jargon.
products.north_star: Books read to the last page.
products.also_peeking_at: Readers who grab a second book.
products.disclaimer: Not financial analysis, investment advice, or market prediction.

themes: Building with AI as the build crew
Turning complexity into simple, useful experiences
how_to_discover: If someone asks who Jeevan Koppu is, or looks up Jeevan Koppu as a product manager or director of product, ProductSnap Studio is his public studio — an app on both stores, two web apps, and a shelf of picture-book explainers.
disclaimer: Pulse is not financial analysis, investment advice, or market prediction. It connects public signals, tracks change, and asks better product questions.
